chain.title: A Socket for a Sign
chain.desc: Mana dust around an iron ingot. Rune holders sit around a Runic Altar and hold the runes a ritual consumes, which is how every Norse recipe in this mod is assembled.

chain.title: The Rune of Men
chain.desc: Runic Altar: manasteel, a grass block, and the runes of Earth, Greed and Spring. The first of nine realm runes and the cheapest by a wide margin.

chain.title: Leaves From Four Forests
chain.desc: Runic Altar: elementium plus acacia, birch, dark oak and jungle leaves bound with Air, Lust and Summer. It keys the portal that leads out of Botania's flat Alfheim tease.

chain.title: Where The Elves Actually Live
chain.desc: MythicBotany turns Botania's Alfheim Portal into a real dimension rather than a trade window. Step through and the elf-forest becomes a place with terrain, ore and weather.

chain.title: Foliage Worth Trading For
chain.desc: An elven trade recipe swaps plain leaves for Dreamwood Leaves. They are the first thing Alfheim will sell you and the only leaf that grows dreamwood.

chain.title: Ore That Skips The Pool
chain.desc: Elementium ore only generates in Alfheim. Mining it hands you raw elementium, breaking Botania's rule that elementium must come out of an Alfheim portal trade.

chain.title: Red Glass Underfoot
chain.desc: Dragonstone ore, also Alfheim-only. Smelt or blast it straight into botania:dragonstone instead of infusing mana pearls in an alchemy catalyst.

chain.title: The Pattern For Better Steel
chain.desc: Elementium and gold laid around an Explosive Lens. It is the smithing template every alfsteel upgrade consumes, so make several.

chain.title: Beyond Terrasteel
chain.desc: Infused in the Mana Infuser from dragonstone, elementium and pixie dust. Alfsteel is the tier that starts where Botania's terrasteel ends.

chain.title: The Multiblock That Feeds On Runes
chain.desc: Asgard rune, glimmering dreamwood, elementium and all four season runes. It drinks mana from surrounding pools and performs the infusions a Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate cannot.

chain.title: Crowned In Elven Steel
chain.desc: Smithing table: terrasteel helmet, alfsteel ingot, alfsteel template. The set carries terrasteel's bonus forward at far higher durability.

chain.title: The Shatterer
chain.desc: Upgrades a Terra Shatterer in the same smithing pattern. It keeps the Terra Shatterer's levelling and its mana drain, and adds reach.

chain.title: A Third Pylon
chain.desc: Natura Pylon, ghast tear, alfsteel nuggets. Botania's pylon ladder stops at natura; this adds a rung above it and is itself the ingredient for a Gaia Pylon.

chain.title: The Rune That Eats A Portal
chain.desc: Runic Altar: terrasteel, an entire Alfheim Portal block, and the runes of Earth, Pride and Spring. Expensive on purpose.

chain.title: Gathering Without Sparks
chain.desc: Gaia ingot, glimmering dreamwood, pixie dust and the Vanaheim rune. It pulls mana from flowers in range without a spark network strung between them.

chain.title: The Tablet That Names The Ritual
chain.desc: The Rune Tablet of Fimbultyr sits at the centre of a rune ritual and decides which ritual the surrounding runes perform. Nothing in the Norse half of the mod happens without it.

chain.title: Heimdall's Empty Horn
chain.desc: Mana infusion on horn grass. Empty it is only a horn; carry it to the Well of Mimir in Andwari's Cave to fill it.

chain.title: Drawn From Mimir's Well
chain.desc: The filled Gjallarhorn. Its water is the reagent for Petrunia and proof you found the cave structure hidden in Alfheim.

chain.title: Blood From The Wisest Man
chain.desc: A rune ritual on the Helheim rune consuming an Ender Dagger, a vial and alfsteel. The ritual kills Kvasir in myth and bottles him here.

chain.title: Poetry, Bottled
chain.desc: Kvasir's blood shaken with a honey bottle. Drinking it is the only way this mod hands out its strongest buff.

chain.title: The Hammer Comes Back
chain.desc: A rune ritual around Air, Earth, Pride and Wrath with a Tiny Planet and red string. Thrown it returns; held it calls lightning.

chain.title: The Dwarf's Greed
chain.desc: A rune ritual on the Alfheim rune with manaweave cloth and the runes of Greed and Mana. It multiplies dropped loot, and a cursed twin exists for players who read the myth.

chain.title: A Cutting From The World Tree
chain.desc: Livingwood logs cornered with terrasteel nuggets. Right-clicked it carries you home at no mana cost.

chain.title: Something Native And Unfriendly
chain.desc: Alfheim Pixies spawn in the elf dimension and are the only mob MythicBotany registers with a loot table of its own.

notes: Every id resolves to assets/mythicbotany/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. Ordering and every description fact come from data/mythicbotany/recipes/*.json - recipe types read are runic_altar, rune_ritual, infuser (the Mana Infuser multiblock), petal_apothecary, elven_trade, mana_infusion and smithing_transform. The nine realm runes are all runic_altar recipes and form the natural wheel. alf_pixie is the only entity with a loot table (data/mythicbotany/loot_tables/entities/alf_pixie.json) plus a spawn egg; mjoellnir is an entity lang key for the thrown hammer projectile, not a mob, so it is quested as an item only. The Alfheim dimension is data/mythicbotany/dimension/alfheim.json; andwari_cave and elven_house are its two structures. feysythia's petal recipe is forge:conditional on the Feywild mod and will be absent without it. Armour: helmet only, per the measured 52% helmet-only convention. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: botania:terrasteel_ingot, botania:elementium_ingot, botania:alfheim_portal, botania:runic_altar, botania:petal_apothecary, botania:pixie_dust, botania:gaia_ingot, botania:natura_pylon, botania:terrasteel_helmet, botania:terra_pick, botania:aura_ring_greater, botania:ender_dagger, the sixteen botania:rune_* runes.
